additional_info.subject: Problems during commission- 170001152
additional_info.body:
Hello Colleagues,
Today, during a charging station commission attempt, I ran into a bunch of problems.
As soon as the charging station went up to the SCB for the first time after connecting it to the electricity, it was updated to FW 2.5.2, therefore we directly attempted an initial update to 2.11 via USB as in every commission we do, the update is of course done in chronological order.
In any case the update failed numerous times
The HMI screen is stuck at 70 percent status:
There were a minimal number of logs in Error flags from the SCB (while the HMI screen still shows 70 percent), no logs appeared in Show logs.
(PLC was on RUN mode)
I ran a test in MobaXterm for the IP addresses on both routers, it looked fine.
10.20.17.1--- 8 IP addresses
10.20.17.2--- 7 IP addresses
After numerous failed attempts to understand the problem, we had to end the day the site is in a very remote location, on the way I saw on the SCB that the charging station was back to full communication intermittently on the SCB with several problems:
- SECC_DC1_MB_Problem
- SECC_DC2_MB_Problem
- Outlet 1 LEM Unavailable (I tried to delete the IP address in the SCB to check if this is some LEM problem, but the problem remains in the SCB, for the information the address is still missing in the SCB I will return it as soon as I have communication back with a charging station)
The SCB lost communication many times during this time as well, I looked at the logs and saw that a reboot was sent by the router many times:
Charging station is now in the remote FW update sent by me (takes a lot of time over an hour after Activ update is activated, I think because of all the problems I mentioned)
FYI, I tried a KF11 replacement attempt, I keep spare parts during once we get to the commission, that didn't help either and the problem remains the same.
Please investigate the case in depth and share the information with L3, we request a meeting on the site with a support team, please also provide us with a list of spare parts, if necessary, the site is very remote for us.
Please help us in this case as soon as possible.
Br,
Orel.
